name: The anniversary timeline

content.text:
Write the first day here — not the polished version you tell at dinner parties, the real one. What you were wearing, what you were worried about, the thing you almost didn't say.

That's the version worth keeping.

content.caption: The earliest photo you can find

content.text: Add a moment for each year below. Small ones count — the flat with the broken heating counts more than the holiday photos.

content.caption: Tap any photo to see it properly.

content.text: Replace this with the thing you always say to each other. The daft one. That's the one.
For the days that need it

memories.description: Name it. It belongs in the story as much as the good parts do.

openWhen.content: Something short and kind. They will not have the energy to read a lot.

openWhen.label: we've argued
openWhen.content: Write this one while you're getting on well. That's the whole point of it.

openWhen.content: The plain version. No jokes in this one.

futureLetter.title: Read this on our next anniversary
futureLetter.content: Write to the two of you a year from now. Guess at what will have happened. Being wrong is half the fun of reading it back.
